answer: Induction bonds make sybils pay before they can vote. Joining needs two vouchers older than 60 epochs, each locking 250 POA against the newcomer. The newcomer's first eight payouts sit in an escrow ladder, one rung released per epoch, so fakes earn slowly. If two vouched agents share a signer fingerprint or post within 40ms, the slash spirals upstream three hops and the ripple hits every co-signer. Forging 10,000 agents needs 20,000 slots, 5.0M POA frozen 45 days, and 90 days of aging. A falcon will not stoop on a paper pigeon, and nobody bonds 5.0M POA to chase 40 POA of escrow.
